T:P1.2.text: We are committed to conducting business in a safe and protective manner that promotes sustainable environments and respects community values.

T:P1.3.text: As sustainability focused company, growth expands Par Pacific’s ability to create a positive impact. As we deepen our operational focus, we remain dedicated to delivering safe, reliable, affordable, and increasingly low-carbon energy to support the needs of our local communities.

T:P1.5.text: As a market leader, we actively seek opportunities to own and operate energy and infrastructure businesses in logistically-complex markets.

T:P2.6.text: Working at Par Pacific is vibrant and fun. Since we are a smaller energy company, employees can make a meaningful impact on the business and to influence decisions.

T:P2.7.text: Our Mission Captures Who We Are & Guides Us Toward Who We Want to Become

T:P2.8.text: Our Mission, Humbly Serving Communities, is about people – our communities, our teams, and the purpose that binds us. Each word matters. We listen first, lead by lifting others, and we’re in this together in each of the communities that we serve.

T:P2.9.text: Par Pacific is a values-driven company. Our tight-knit community values respect for others, integrity, collaborative innovation, and heart. These four pillars support our successes and strengthen our ability to be an effective and fun place to work.

T:P2.10.text: We listen before we speak, yet understand action is needed for progress. We value the unique heritage, experiences, and contributions of everyone and everywhere we are blessed to work with and serve.

T:P2.11.text: Creativity drives innovation and fuels the generation of new ideas. We understand creativity alone is not enough. It is through collaborative innovation that we bring those ideas to life ! Through our collaborative efforts and effective systems, these ideas become impactful results that open new worlds of opportunity.

T:P2.12.text: An ounce of heart is worth more than a ton of intellect and talent. We care deeply about the communities in which we operate. We succeed when our hard work, grit and resilience is balanced with good rest. We root for each other, celebrate each other ’ s successes and learn from our mistakes.

C:P3.2.text: Information and background information on Ingles Dietitian Leah McGrath

C:P3.3.text: Leah McGrath has been a Registered Dietitian. She holds degrees in Speech Communications (BA-1983 West Chester University) and Human Nutrition (BS-1995 University of Maryland) and has completed course work towards a master's degree in Marketing. Additionally Leah has received certification from the Cooper Institute on Health Promotion and completed certification courses in food safety, neonatal nutrition, and as a breastfeeding consultant.

C:P3.4.text: Leah completed her dietetic internship with the US Army at Walter Reed Army Medical Center in Washington, DC and then became the Chief, Clinical Dietetics at Moncrief Army Hospital, Fort Jackson in Columbia, SC. After resigning her active duty commission in the Army, Leah worked for almost two years with the South Carolina Department of Public Health. Initially she worked as the Lead Nutritionist for the Low Country Health District; but soon became the WIC (Women, Infants, and Children) and ...

C:P3.5.text: Leah accepted the position with Ingles Supermarkets as their Corporate Dietitian and moved to Asheville, NC and is a licensed dietitian in North Carolina.

C:P3.6.text: Leah writes regularly for WNC Parent Magazine, Upstate Parent Magazine, Smoky Mountain News and Smoky Mountain Living magazine and the Asheville Citizen Times. She is a frequent guest on WLOS-TV (ABC) in Asheville and Your Carolina in Greenville SC where she presents recipe and nutrition information segments. She also hosts the weekly radio program, "Ingles Information Aisle" on WWNC 570am which can be heard anywhere in the world through the Iheart radio network.

C:P3.7.text: Leah has been a guest speaker for numerous hospitals and businesses throughout the Southeast. She also regularly speaks to Nutrition Departments at many colleges and universities including Clemson University, Winthrop University, East Tennessee State, University of Tennessee, University of Georgia, Georgia State University and Appalachian State. Leah has presented at the Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics Annual Meeting (2013 and 2015), the world’s largest meeting for nutrition professionals. She has been a featured speaker for the North Carolina, South Carolina, ...

C:P3.8.text: In the past few years Leah has become well known for her work in social media and is currently the most followed supermarket dietitian ( @InglesDietitian) in the U.S on Twitter. She coordinates both the Facebook and Twitter accounts for Ingles Markets and has developed innovative strategies to connect brands and products to consumers and inform customers about health and nutrition.
